fixtures.fixed/retention_test.go:
package main

import (
	"runtime"
	"testing"
)

func TestRetainedHeap(t *testing.T) {
	header = nil
	t.Cleanup(func() { header = nil })
	runtime.GC()
	var before, after runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
	header = readHeader()
	runtime.GC()
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&after)
	delta := int64(after.HeapAlloc) - int64(before.HeapAlloc)
	runtime.KeepAlive(header)
	t.Logf("retained Go heap delta: %d bytes", delta)
	if delta > 1<<20 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected retained heap: %d", delta)
	}
}
fixtures.original/retention_test.go:
package main

import (
	"runtime"
	"testing"
)

func TestRetainedHeap(t *testing.T) {
	header = nil
	t.Cleanup(func() { header = nil })
	runtime.GC()
	var before, after runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
	header = readHeader()
	runtime.GC()
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&after)
	delta := int64(after.HeapAlloc) - int64(before.HeapAlloc)
	runtime.KeepAlive(header)
	t.Logf("retained Go heap delta: %d bytes", delta)
	if delta < 90<<20 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected retained heap: %d", delta)
	}
}

go.race: Not run: no application concurrency added.
go.limits: No physical-memory/RSS assertions; Go HeapAlloc checked with generous thresholds. No older toolchain executions. Exact Clone capacity deliberately not asserted.

retained_heap.metric: MemStats.HeapAlloc after forced GC minus baseline after forced GC
retained_heap.assertions: Original delta >= 90 MiB; fixed delta <= 1 MiB, with the global result kept reachable.
retained_heap.interpretation: One Go 1.26.1 run, generous thresholds. Negative small delta reflects unrelated heap variation, not negative memory use. Not RSS and not a promise of exact allocation overhead.

structure.scope: Syntax and structural checks only; not Go correctness, translation equivalence, UI or automatic review completion.
